study_identification_part.si_4_title: Neuroanatomical heterogeneity and homogeneity in individuals at clinical high risk for psychosis

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ENIGMA CHR-P consortium pooled across 29 sites; includes CHR-P and HC participants.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The ENIGMA CHR-P dataset amalgamated clinical and neuroimaging data from 29 sites, comprising 1579 individuals meeting CHR-P criteria ... and 1243 HC participants."

answer.ENIGMA-CHR-P: Primary dataset for CHR-P vs HC analyses; HC group used as normative reference for PBSI deviation (normativeness)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: HC participants provide the normative reference (average HC profile) for PBSI z-scores; CHR-P participants are compared against HC and analyzed for deviation.
